_comment: Synthetic incidents and seeded fix PRs (Story 25). All data is fabricated — no real company incidents, logs, or recordings. The seeder (incident_backend/seed.py) loads this into the backend; in production the same loader reads real approved postmortems instead.

incidents.title: Payment 409 after idempotency key change
incidents.cause: Deploy abc123 changed the idempotency key to include a timestamp, so retried charges no longer matched and the gateway returned 409 Conflict.
incidents.fix: Reverted the key change in PR #42 so the idempotency key is the order id again; 409s cleared within minutes.

incidents.title: Payment timeouts from a missing database index
incidents.cause: A new fraud-check query did a full table scan on transactions; under load it exceeded the 2s gateway timeout.
incidents.fix: Added a composite index on (account_id, created_at) in PR #51; p95 query time dropped from 2.4s to 40ms.

incidents.title: Checkout 503 after a bad feature-flag rollout
incidents.cause: A feature flag enabled the new checkout for 100% of traffic before the backing service was scaled, so the pods OOM-killed and returned 503.
incidents.fix: Rolled the flag back to 5% in PR #88 and raised the memory limit; 503s stopped immediately.
